review_candidates.title: Affiliate Manager
review_candidates.description: Position: Affiliate Manager Department: Commercial Department Reports to: Head of E-Commerce / Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) Job Overview The Affiliate Manager is responsible for developing, implementing, and managing the overall affiliate marketing strategy to drive revenue growth, customer acquisition, and brand visibility across key e-commerce and social commerce platforms, including TikTok Shop, Shopee, and Lazada. This role oversees end-to-end affiliate operations, including affiliate recruitment, creator partnerships, campaign planning, commission management, performance optimization, and budget allocation to maximize sales performance and return on investment (ROI). The Affiliate Manager also leads the affiliate team, builds and maintains strong relationships with KOLs, KOCs, content creators, and affiliate partners, and collaborates closely with E-Commerce, Marketing, and Content teams to ensure alignment with overall commercial objectives and business growth targets. Core Functions & Key Responsibilities Affiliate Strategy & Business Growth Develop and execute affiliate marketing strategies aligned with business objectives, brand positioning, and revenue targets. Establish monthly, quarterly, and annual affiliate sales targets and key performance indicators, including GMV, revenue contribution, and ROI. Identify growth opportunities through market trends, competitor analysis, consumer insights, and emerging affiliate platforms. Develop and optimize strategies to increase affiliate-driven revenue, conversion rates, and overall contribution to e-commerce sales. Affiliate Recruitment & Partnership Management Develop and implement strategies to recruit, activate, and retain high-performing affiliates, KOLs, KOCs, and content creators, including negotiating partnership terms, commission structures, and incentive programs to maximize commercial effectiveness. Evaluate and select affiliate partners based on audience relevance, content quality, engagement, sales performance, and brand alignment. Build and maintain strategic relationships with affiliate partners to drive long-term collaboration and sustainable revenue growth. Develop affiliate segmentation and engagement strategies to improve partner productivity, retention, and overall network performance. Affiliate Campaign Planning & Execution Plan and execute affiliate marketing campaigns across TikTok Shop, Shopee, Lazada, and other relevant platforms. Develop campaign strategies, promotional mechanics, and creator incentives for key sales events, product launches, and seasonal campaigns. Oversee product seeding, sampling programs, and creator activation initiatives to drive content creation and sales conversion. Monitor campaign execution to ensure alignment with approved plans, timelines, budgets, and performance targets. Evaluate campaign results and implement improvements to enhance future campaign effectiveness. Affiliate Performance Management & Optimization Monitor and analyze affiliate performance across key metrics, including GMV, conversion rates, ROI, ROAS, and revenue contribution. Evaluate individual affiliate performance, content effectiveness, and conversion trends to identify optimization opportunities. Develop improvement plans for underperforming affiliates and scale high-performing partnerships and content. Prepare regular performance reports, business insights, and strategic recommendations for management. Budget Management & Commercial Efficiency Plan, manage, and allocate affiliate marketing budgets across platforms, campaigns, and creator partnerships to maximize cost efficiency. Oversee commission expenses, creator incentives, product seeding costs, and other affiliate-related investments. Monitor Cost-to-Income Ratio (CIR), ROI, and budget utilization to ensure alignment with financial targets. Evaluate investment effectiveness and identify opportunities to optimize spending while maintaining revenue growth. Collaborate with Finance and E-Commerce teams to ensure accurate expense tracking, commission payments, and budget control. Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration Lead, manage, and develop the affiliate marketing team to achieve departmental objectives and performance targets. Define team responsibilities, establish individual KPIs, and provide coaching and performance feedback to enhance team effectiveness. Collaborate with E-Commerce, Marketing, Brand, Content, and Creative teams to align affiliate initiatives with commercial strategies and campaign priorities. Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure product availability, promotional readiness, and seamless campaign execution. Establish and improve operational workflows, reporting processes, and team practices to enhance efficiency and overall performance. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, E-Commerce, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of experience in Affiliate Marketing, Influencer Marketing, E-Commerce, Digital Marketing, or related fields. At least 2 years of experience in a managerial or team leadership role. Proven experience managing affiliate marketing programs across TikTok Shop, Shopee, Lazada, or other relevant e-commerce platforms. Strong experience in developing affiliate strategies, managing creator partnerships, and driving measurable sales growth. Experience in the Beauty, Skincare, Cosmetics, FMCG, or Consumer Goods industry is highly preferred. Technical Skills & Knowledge Strong understanding of affiliate marketing ecosystems, social commerce, and e-commerce platforms. In-depth knowledge of TikTok Shop Affiliate, Shopee Affiliate, and relevant creator marketing tools. Strong understanding of KOL/KOC marketing, creator partnerships, and performance-based marketing models. Ability to analyze affiliate performance using GMV, ROI, ROAS, CIR, conversion rates, and other commercial metrics. Experience in managing affiliate commission structures, campaign budgets, and performance optimization. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and performance reporting tools. Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate performance data into actionable business strategies. Good understanding of social media trends, consumer behavior, and content-driven commerce.

review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 岗位职责 1. 负责智能眼镜整机系统需求分析与分解，将产品需求转化为硬件、RTOS、系统软件、App、算法、云端和测试可执行的系统需求。 2. 建立并维护系统需求规格、需求追踪矩阵和变更影响分析，确保需求无遗漏、实现可追踪、验收有依据。 3. 设计和维护整机逻辑架构、关键业务链路、系统状态机、软硬件边界及跨模块接口基线。 4. 组织跨域技术方案评审，识别接口冲突、资源竞争、时序问题和异常场景，并推动责任团队闭环。 5. 定义并分解性能、时延、功耗、热、稳定性、容量、安全、兼容性等非功能指标，推动形成可测量的预算与验收方法。 6. 负责关键使用场景和异常场景分析，包括连接与回连、网络切换、低电量、休眠唤醒、升级、追踪丢失、资源抢占、服务降级与故障恢复等。 7. 建立系统风险分析机制，运用FMEA、故障树或同类方法维护系统风险、应对措施和验证证据。 8. 参与样机、版本和重大功能的系统集成，制定系统验证与验收方案，推动端到端问题定位和跨团队闭环。 9. 识别跨产品公共能力与产品差异，推动接口、协议、组件和系统能力复用，控制分支和定制复杂度。 任职要求 1. 计算机、电子、通信、自动化或相关专业本科及以上学历，8年以上复杂智能硬件或嵌入式系统研发/系统工程经验。 2. 有智能眼镜、AR/VR、手机、可穿戴、机器人、智能座舱、IoT终端等至少一类复杂软硬件产品的整机量产或交付经验。 3. 熟悉从产品需求、系统需求、架构设计、模块分解、集成验证到量产/发布的完整研发过程。 4. 能跨越硬件、嵌入式、操作系统、App、算法和云服务进行系统分析，能够判断接口、状态、时序、资源和异常处理是否完整。 5. 具备系统需求与接口工程能力，能独立产出需求规格、架构图、接口文档、状态机、时序图、追踪矩阵和验收标准。 6. 熟悉性能、功耗、时延、稳定性和故障恢复等非功能设计，能够把抽象目标拆为可测量指标。 7. 具备复杂问题分析能力，能基于日志、链路、复现条件和实验数据组织跨团队根因定位，而非停留在协调和转述层面。 8. 具备良好的技术判断和推动能力，能在没有直接行政管理权的情况下推动产品、研发、算法、硬件和质量团队形成结论。 9. 具有较强的文档能力和评审能力，能控制需求歧义、方案缺口和变更影响。

review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 职责描述： 1、负责人形机器人机身、头部、移动底盘、感知传感器集成模块的机械方案定义与全流程结构开发； 2、主导一体化关节模组（集成电机、减速器、力矩传感器、驱动器）选型，解决散热、走线、密封、装配工艺问题。 3、针对机器人关键受力部件、传动组件开展系统性的静力学、动力学与疲劳寿命仿真分析，输出可落地的优化方案，从设计源头规避结构断裂、刚度不足、精度衰减等风险； 4、输出机器人产品的3D、2D图纸输出，输出完成BOM清单; 5、主导机械人与整机样机的装配调试、性能测试与失效分析，快速定位并闭环解决结构关键问题，推动样机快速迭代； 6、协同NPI与供应链团队，完成零部件DFM/DFA工艺评审、工装夹具开发与量产工艺优化，打通从样机试制到批量转产的全流程落地路径。 任职要求： 1、统招本科及以上学历，机械设计制造及其自动化、机械工程、机械电子工程、机电一体化等相关专业，具备扎实的机械原理与精密传动理论基础； 2、5年以上机械结构设计经验，有轮式人形机器人、足式人形机器人、机械臂、末端夹爪、高端自动化设备开发经验者优先。 3、精通各类执行机构的原理和设计方法，可独立完成关节模组、伺服电机、谐波减速器/行星减速器、六维力传感器等核心传动部件的参数计算与选型匹配； 4、作为核心设计负责人完整主导过3个及以上量产级机器人或复杂机电系统项目的核心模块开发，独立拆解并解决复杂工程问题。 5、精通注塑、压铸、机加、钣金模具和加工工艺，；精通SW、Creo等3D建模软件，握ANSYS、ADAMS等仿真工具开展结构分析与优化。； 6、具备优秀的团队协作能力与沟通能力，能承受较强的工作压力。良好的自我驱动与学习能力、系统思维能力、责任感强，对机器人有很高的热情。
